description: Renovate complements Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml): Dependabot raises PRs for minor/patch updates and auto-merges them; Renovate only tracks major updates, which wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening PRs, and moves the Node.js version in one grouped PR.

packageRules.description: Leave minor and patch updates to Dependabot
Actions are left to Dependabot, except the Node version the workflows use
Majors are deliberate: list them on the dashboard, open a PR only when approved there
Node.js: one PR moving .nvmrc, engines, @types/node, the Dockerfile and the workflows together; LTS (even) majors only
